# Map marker — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the map marker when the host engine needs something painted at a position: the positioned marker visual, nothing more. `kind` picks the treatment — the default pin disc, host-icon vehicle and person, the consent guest, or the label-chip stop — and `tone` resolves through the one tone registry, so markers agree with pills, discs and deltas everywhere rather than carrying a local palette. `selected` rings the marker in primary while `live` adds the static halo — no decorative motion, ever — and the guest kind paints the consented live position with a dashed consent ring while sharing and a neutral tone with a paused dot on expiry. There is deliberately no engine inside — coordinates, tiles, camera, clustering and gestures stay in the platform map system, with the marker positioned by the host's style — no interaction, since an activating marker is the host engine's hit-target, and no consent or streaming logic, since the visual only paints the props it is given.

There is deliberately no engine inside — coordinates, tiles, camera, clustering and gestures stay in the platform map system, with the marker positioned by the host's style — no interaction, since an activating marker is the host engine's hit-target, and no consent or streaming logic, since the visual only paints the props it is given.
